versions.short: The bill would extend existing whistleblower protections to employees of companies working under Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) contracts and grants, including those signed before the current law took effect. Under current law, workers for federal contractors or grant recipients are protected from firing, demotion, or discrimination for reporting certain misconduct involving federal money to Congress or other appropriate officials. Those protections currently cover only contracts and grants signed or changed after the law took effect, and the bill would remove that limit for HUD-funded work.
